title: Malicious code in pmhq-dist-win-x64 (npm)
description: The npm package pmhq-dist-win-x64 version 9.0.2 contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised device. Removing the package alone does not guarantee full remediation, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
